paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: copy any image from the conversation straight to the clipboard. Replaces the built-in li
ghtbox (close button only) with a viewer that has Copy, Save, zoom and page-through.
# dsh-copy-image
**Copy any image out of a DeepSeek Harness conversation — one click, straight to the clipboard.**
中文 | English
> **The problem.** DSH renders chat pictures, but the built-in lightbox has a mask, the picture, and
a close button — nothing else. There is no way to get the picture out except save-then-drag. Copy w

orks for text (it is a normal selection) and not for images.
>
> **The fix.** This plugin adds a vie
wer that opens on click and puts **复制 / Copy** where you expect it.
## English
### What you get
Click any image in the transcript and a full-screen viewer opens with:
| Control | What it does |

| **复制 / Copy** | Encodes the image to PNG and writes it to the OS clipboard |
| **保存 / Save** | Sav

es it as a PNG file |
| **− / 1× / +** | Zoom 1×–8×, with wheel zoom and drag-to-pan when zoomed |
|

**‹ / ›** | Page through the other images of the same message |
| **✕ / Esc** | Close |
The overlay never moves or reparents DSH's DOM nodes — it only listens on the document and draws int
o its own body portal. That is deliberate: DSH renders the transcript with a React virtual list, and
reparenting its nodes makes React throw `removeChild` afterwards.
### Why copying works here
Two separate problems had to be solved, and the first version of this plugin only solved one of them
wo separate problems had to be solved, and the first version of this plugin only solved one of them.
**Getting the pixels.** `toBlob` needs a PNG blob, a blob needs a decoded image, and reading pixels
needs the canvas to stay untainted. The desktop shell serves the UI from the `dsh-app://app` custom
scheme (`secure: true`, `corsEnabled: true`), so an `` load is allowed.
Three routes are tried in order — CORS-visible load, then `fetch` + `blob:` decode, then a plain lo
ad — so that Save keeps working even on hosts that send no CORS header.
**Writing the clipboard.** This is the part that failed. In an Electron renderer the harness install
s a per-session permission handler, and `navigator.clipboard.write` rejects when it says no. The rej
ection is silent from the user's point of view: the button appears to do nothing.
The fix is to write the clipboard from the **host process**, which is not behind that gate:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`navigator.clipboard.write` is still attempted as a fallback, for the plain-browser profile where no
d.write` is still attempted as a fallback, for the plain-browser profile where no host route exists.
### Install
**From GitHub (recommended, no registry needed):**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**In the GUI:** sidebar **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste `github:447662/dsh-copy-image`, install.
**Local checkout (for development — edits take effect on page refresh):**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **fully quit DSH and reopen** (closing the window is not enough — background processes keep the
old bundle loaded).
### Requirements

- DSH kernel `>= 0.1.7-rc.1`. Verified against `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- Desktop shell or web profile. The cop
y path prefers the `dsh-app://app` scheme; in a plain browser tab on `http://127.0.0.1`, clipboard w
rites require the secure-context allowance that localhost has.
### Fixed in 0.2.0
- **The page froze after using the viewer.** The closed overlay was hidden with `opacity: 0` only, s
o the invisible full-viewport backdrop still swallowed every click and drag — the app looked dead, a
nd neither Esc nor scrolling helped. It is now `display: none` + `pointer-events: none` while closed

.
- **Copy did nothing.** See "Why copying works here" — the clipboard is now written host-side.
- *
*Right-click froze the viewer.** Only a left click opens the viewer now; right and middle clicks are
froze the viewer.** Only a left click opens the viewer now; right and middle clicks are left alone.
### Known limitations
- **SVG images are skipped.** Rasterising them needs a serializer that is not worth the byte count h

ere; use the right-click "save image" on the original instead.
- **Very large images may be slow to

copy.** The whole picture is re-encoded at native resolution; a 200-megapixel PNG takes a moment.
-
**The original lightbox is replaced, not augmented.** Clicking an image opens this viewer instead of

DSH's. Uninstalling restores the original behaviour immediately.
- **No right-click menu.** Copy li
ves on the viewer toolbar, which is where a picture can actually be read from.
### Privacy
The host half registers two loopback-only routes (`/copy`, `/ping`). `/copy` accepts PNG bytes, writ
es a temp file, runs PowerShell to put it on the clipboard, then deletes the temp file. It takes no
caller-supplied path, reads no other file and makes no network calls. The browser half only reads im
age URLs DSH has already rendered. Nothing is sent anywhere.
### 功能
点击对话里的任意图片，打开全屏查看器：
| 控件 | 作用 |

| **复制** | 把图片编码成 PNG 写进系统剪贴板 |
| **保存** | 存成 PNG 文件 |
| **− / 1× / +** | 1×–8× 缩放；放大后可滚轮缩放、拖拽平移 |
|

**‹ / ›** | 在同一条消息的其他图片之间翻页 |
| **✕ / Esc** | 关闭 |
浮层**绝不移动或重挂 DSH 的 DOM 节点**，只监听 document、把界面画进自己的 body portal。这是刻意的：DSH 用 React 虚拟列表渲染对话，重挂它的节点会让 Rea
ct 之后抛 `removeChild`。
### 已知限制

- **跳过 SVG 图片**：栅格化 SVG 需要一个序列化器，为此增加体积不划算；请对 SVG 原图用右键另存。
- **超大图复制会慢**：整图按原始分辨率重新编码，两亿像素的 PNG 要等一下

。
- **替换而非叠加原生灯箱**：点图打开的是本插件的查看器，不再是 DSH 的。卸载即恢复原行为。
- **不做右键菜单**：复制按钮放在查看器工具栏上——那才是能真正读到图片像素的地方。
### 隐私
宿主半区只注册两条仅限本机回环的路由（`/copy`、`/ping`）：前者接收 PNG 字节、写临时文件、调 PowerShell 放进剪贴板、然后删掉临时文件；不接受任意路径、不读取其他文件、不发
网络请求。浏览器半区只读取 DSH 已经渲染出来的图片地址。不上传任何东西。
